observations: Photo 0: a loose used petrol car engine sitting on a dirty workshop floor, not a car.
It is a V-configuration engine with the top cover off, injector wiring, coil packs, throttle body, alternator, belt pulleys and an air filter box on the left.
A separate gearbox or engine assembly is partly visible at bottom left.
No engine code, block stamp, badge or label is readable in the photo.
Watermarks read 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'VICTOR MAZECO'; camera tag reads 'SPARK 30C'.
Grease and dust consistent with a pulled engine; no damage visible but internals cannot be judged.

read_from: photo 0 shows an engine, but no make, model or engine code is readable

claims.evidence: No Lexus or Toyota badge, cover marking or engine code is readable in photo 0. Note there is no Lexus LX 460 model, so the fitment claim is itself doubtful.

claims.claim: Japan engine (foreign used, imported from Japan)
claims.evidence: Origin cannot be seen in a photo; no import papers or tags shown.

claims.claim: car (the listing is for a car)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a loose engine, not a vehicle.

risks.risk: Exact engine model and code unknown, and that code sets the price (V6 versus V8, which family).
risks.proof: Close, sharp photo of the engine code stamped on the block and the label on the engine or ECU.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; identity must be read first

risks.risk: Engine may not run, or may have low compression, knock or internal damage.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running on a test stand or in a car, with a cold start and idle sound, or a compression test reading on camera.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-running engine for parts

risks.risk: Missing or damaged accessories and electronics (ECU, wiring harness, alternator, starter, AC compressor).
risks.proof: Walk-around clip of all four sides of the engine showing every accessory and the harness, plus the ECU if included.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare engine without accessories or ECU

risks.risk: Oil sludge, coolant mixing or overheating history.
risks.proof: Photo of the dipstick and under the oil filler cap, and of the coolant passages.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code stamped on the block and any engine label
Video of the engine running, cold start and idle
Walk-around clip of all sides showing accessories, harness and ECU
Photo of the dipstick and under the oil filler cap
Handwritten note with today's date and the seller's name in shot with the engine
response.reason: This is a used car engine, but no make, model or engine code is readable and the seller's 'LX460' does not match a real Lexus model, so the engine family that sets the price is unknown. The engine code photo is needed before even a worst case price is possible.
